name: GitHub Repo Metrics to Google Sheets

nodes.name: Split Repos
nodes.notes: Splits the 'items' array from GitHub API response into individual repository items

nodes.name: Configuration
nodes.notes:
Configure these values:
- programming_language: javascript, python, java, etc.
- sort_by: stars, forks, or updated
- spreadsheet_id: Your Google Sheet ID from the URL
- sheet_name: Target sheet name
- results_per_page: Max 100
- max_pages: How many pages to process
- current_page: Starting page (keep as 1)
- include_code_metrics: Whether to calculate lines/chars (slower)
- max_file_size_kb: Skip files larger than this (default 500KB)
